instructions: Step:1 Settle onto your back with your knees bent and feet planted.
Step:2 Reach your arms out to the sides, perpendicular to your body.
Step:3 Set the pelvis and make the turn through the rib cage.
Step:4 Turn through the torso while the hips and lower body stay as steady as the setup allows.
Step:5 Keep the turn smooth instead of throwing the arms across the body.
Step:6 Return through center before turning to the other side.

name: Cable Single-Arm Incline Press On Exercise Ball
instructions: Step:1 Take a seat on an exercise ball with your feet planted and your back resting against an incline bench.
Step:2 Take a cable handle in one hand and position your arm at a 90-degree angle with your elbow bent.
Step:3 Brace the torso and align the wrists with the forearms.
Step:4 Press the weight or handles away while keeping your trunk braced.
Step:5 Keep both shoulders level and resist turning toward the working arm.
Step:6 Lower the weight to its starting height under control before pressing again; switch sides when the set calls for it.

name: EZ-Bar Curl
instructions: Step:1 Stand tall with your feet about shoulder width and hold the ez barbell with palms facing up.
Step:2 Hold your elbows near your torso and your upper arms stationary throughout the movement.
Step:3 Set the shoulders and upper arms before bending the elbows.
Step:4 Bend your elbows to bring the weight toward your shoulders without swinging your torso.
Step:5 Keep the torso quiet and let the elbow bend lift the weight.
Step:6 Lower until the elbows are nearly straight, keeping the upper arms still.

name: Hanging Straight-Leg Raise
instructions: Step:1 Suspend yourself from a pull-up bar with your arms straight and your palms turned away from you.
Step:2 Brace your trunk and lift your legs up in front of you, keeping them straight.
Step:3 Brace the abdomen and keep the shoulders anchored to the support.
Step:4 Lift your legs by bracing your trunk and moving at the hips rather than swinging.
Step:5 Slow the legs before they pull the lower back out of position.
Step:6 Lower the legs slowly without swinging or losing your trunk position.

name: Twisted Leg Raise
instructions: Step:1 Settle onto your back with your legs extended and your arms by your sides.
Step:2 Bend your knees and lift your legs off the ground, bringing them toward your chest.
Step:3 Brace the abdomen and keep the shoulders anchored to the support.
Step:4 Lift your legs by bracing your trunk and moving at the hips rather than swinging.
Step:5 Slow the legs before they pull the lower back out of position.
Step:6 Lower the legs slowly without swinging or losing your trunk position.

name: quads (bodyweight squat)
instructions: Step:1 Stand and set your feet about shoulder width.
Step:2 Before moving, lower your body by bending your knees and pushing your hips back as if sitting on a chair.
Step:3 Brace the abdomen and spread pressure across the whole foot.
Step:4 Bend at the hips and knees to lower, keeping your feet grounded and knees tracking with the toes.
Step:5 Drive upward with the chest and hips rising together; keep the knees from collapsing inward.
Step:6 Stand fully, reset your footing and breathing, then begin the next descent.

name: sit-up with arms on chest
instructions: Step:1 Settle onto your back with your knees bent and feet planted.
Step:2 Fold your arms over your chest.
Step:3 Set the pelvis and keep the neck relaxed before curling upward.
Step:4 Curl your rib cage toward your pelvis, letting the abdominals move the torso.
Step:5 Leave a little space between the chin and chest; keep the movement in the torso.
Step:6 Lower the shoulders or torso with control before the next curl.

name: Archer Pull-Up
instructions: Step:1 Begin by hanging from a pull-up bar with palms facing down, just beyond shoulder width.
Step:2 Brace your trunk and pull your shoulder blades down and back.
Step:3 Begin from a controlled hang with the shoulders active rather than slack.
Step:4 Pull your elbows down and bring your upper chest toward the bar without kicking your legs.
Step:5 Avoid swinging the legs to clear the bar.
Step:6 Lower to long arms without dropping suddenly from the top.

name: potty squat
instructions: Step:1 Stand and set your feet about shoulder width, toes pointing slightly outward.
Step:2 Before moving, lower your body down by bending your knees and pushing your hips back as if you were sitting on a chair.
Step:3 Brace the abdomen and spread pressure across the whole foot.
Step:4 Bend at the hips and knees to lower, keeping your feet grounded and knees tracking with the toes.
Step:5 Drive upward with the chest and hips rising together; keep the knees from collapsing inward.
Step:6 Stand fully, reset your footing and breathing, then begin the next descent.

name: Dumbbell Step Up Single Leg Balance With Biceps Curl
instructions: Step:1 Take your place in front of a step or platform with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing your body.
Step:2 Set your right foot on the step, ensuring your entire foot is in contact with the surface.
Step:3 Set the shoulders and upper arms before bending the elbows.
Step:4 Bend your elbows to bring the weight toward your shoulders without swinging your torso.
Step:5 Keep the torso quiet and let the elbow bend lift the weight.
Step:6 Lower until the elbows are nearly straight, keeping the upper arms still.

name: dumbbell step-up lunge
instructions: Step:1 Take your place in front of a step or platform with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing your sides.
Step:2 Set your right foot on the step, ensuring your entire foot is on the surface.
Step:3 Put the lead foot fully on the platform before shifting your weight onto it.
Step:4 Step onto the platform and drive through the lead foot to stand tall on it.
Step:5 Keep the front foot planted and avoid collapsing inward at the knee.
Step:6 Push through the lead foot to return to the start, then change legs as planned.

name: smith incline reverse-grip press
instructions: Step:1 Set the seat of the smith machine to a comfortable incline angle.
Step:2 Take a seat on the machine with your back against the pad and your feet planted.
Step:3 Brace the torso and align the wrists with the forearms.
Step:4 Press the weight or handles away while keeping your trunk braced.
Step:5 Keep the palms in the chosen grip without bending the wrists back.
Step:6 Lower the weight to its starting height under control before pressing again.

name: dumbbell hammer curl
instructions: Step:1 Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing your torso.
Step:2 Hold your elbows near your torso and rotate the palms of your hands until they are facing forward.
Step:3 Set the shoulders and upper arms before bending the elbows.
Step:4 Curl with palms facing each other and elbows near your sides; avoid rocking back.
Step:5 Keep the palms facing each other and the wrists straight.
Step:6 Lower until the elbows are nearly straight, keeping the upper arms still.

name: Dumbbell Over Bench Single-Arm Wrist Curl
instructions: Step:1 Plant both feet while seated on a bench; hold a dumbbell in one hand, palm facing down.
Step:2 Set your forearm on the bench with your wrist hanging off the edge.
Step:3 Keep the elbows relaxed so the small muscles of the hand or forearm take the load.
Step:4 Move through the wrists or fingers while the forearms stay supported and still.
Step:5 Keep both shoulders level and resist turning toward the working arm.
Step:6 Ease back to the start without letting the load fall from your hands; switch sides when the set calls for it.

name: medicine ball chest push multiple response
instructions: Step:1 Stand and set your feet about shoulder width, holding a medicine ball at chest level.
Step:2 Reach your arms forward, pushing the medicine ball away from your chest.
Step:3 Set a firm stance and leave enough clear space for the ball to travel.
Step:4 Drive the ball away forcefully, using the arms and trunk together; catch or retrieve it before resetting.
Step:5 Follow through with the whole body while keeping control of the landing or catch.
Step:6 Bring the weight or body back to its starting position without rushing.

name: triceps dips floor
instructions: Step:1 Take a seat on the edge of a chair or bench with your hands next to your hips, fingers pointing forward.
Step:2 Move your butt off the front of the chair with your legs extended in front of you.
Step:3 Set the shoulders down and keep the elbows pointed mostly behind you.
Step:4 Bend the elbows to lower between the supports; stop at a comfortable shoulder depth.
Step:5 Choose a depth that lets the shoulders stay comfortable.
Step:6 Press through the hands to rise, then reset the shoulders before another rep.

name: Machine Calf Press
instructions: Step:1 Set the seat of the leverage machine so that your shoulders are aligned with the lever pad.
Step:2 Set your toes on the lever pad, with your heels hanging off the edge.
Step:3 Let the ankles move freely while the rest of the body stays quiet.
Step:4 Rise through the balls of your feet, lifting the heels as high as you can without rocking.
Step:5 Pause at the top without rolling the ankles outward.
Step:6 Lower the heels at a measured pace before rising again.

name: Kettlebell Two-Arm Clean
instructions: Step:1 Stand and set your feet about shoulder width, holding a kettlebell ahead of your thighs with both hands, palms facing toward you.
Step:2 Bend your knees slightly and hinge at the hips, lowering the kettlebell toward the ground.
Step:3 Brace before the pull and keep the load close to the body.
Step:4 Drive through the legs and hips, then guide the weight to its receiving position.
Step:5 Receive the load with the torso braced and feet stable.
Step:6 Stand tall to finish, then lower the weight under control before the next rep.

name: dumbbell seated preacher curl
instructions: Step:1 Take a seat on a preacher curl bench with your feet planted.
Step:2 Take a dumbbell in one hand with palms facing up, resting your upper arm against the preacher pad.
Step:3 Set the working upper arm against the preacher pad and leave the elbow free to bend.
Step:4 Curl the weight while your upper arms stay in contact with the pad.
Step:5 Keep the torso quiet and let the elbow bend lift the weight.
Step:6 Lower until the elbows are nearly straight, keeping the upper arms still.

name: Chest Tap Push-Up
instructions: Step:1 Begin in a high plank position with your hands just beyond shoulder width and your body in a straight line.
Step:2 Lower your body toward the ground by bending your elbows, keeping them close to your sides.
Step:3 Brace the abdomen and glutes so the shoulders, hips and ankles move together.
Step:4 Bend your elbows to lower your chest while keeping your body in one line.
Step:5 Keep the head in line with the spine as the elbows bend.
Step:6 Press back to straight arms, keeping the body line intact.

name: exercise ball seated triceps stretch
instructions: Step:1 Take a seat on a stability ball with your feet planted and your back straight.
Step:2 Take a dumbbell in one hand and extend your arm straight up above your head.
Step:3 Settle into the starting position and take an easy breath before moving deeper.
Step:4 Ease toward the stretch until you feel mild tension; keep breathing and avoid bouncing.
Step:5 Keep the ball steady and use the feet to manage your balance.
Step:6 Hold the position with steady breathing, then release gently; repeat on the other side if needed.

name: Machine Front Pulldown
instructions: Step:1 Fit the seat to your body, then settle into the machine.
Step:2 Hold the handles with palms facing down, just beyond shoulder width.
Step:3 Sit tall and set the shoulders before drawing the handle down.
Step:4 Pull the handle down by driving your elbows toward your ribs; keep your torso steady.
Step:5 Pull with the elbows rather than leaning far back to move the handle.
Step:6 Let the handle rise steadily until the arms are long, then reset the shoulders.

name: Dumbbell Seated Single-Arm Rotate
instructions: Step:1 Take a seat on a bench with your back straight and hold a dumbbell in one hand, resting it on your thigh.
Step:2 Before moving, raise the dumbbell up to shoulder height, keeping your elbow close to your body.
Step:3 Keep the elbows relaxed so the small muscles of the hand or forearm take the load.
Step:4 Move through the wrists or fingers while the forearms stay supported and still.
Step:5 Keep both shoulders level and resist turning toward the working arm.
Step:6 Ease back to the start without letting the load fall from your hands; switch sides when the set calls for it.

name: dumbbell lying hammer press
instructions: Step:1 Settle onto a bench with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing each other and arms extended straight up.
Step:2 Before moving, lower the dumbbells to the sides of your chest, keeping your elbows at a 90-degree angle.
Step:3 Brace the torso and align the wrists with the forearms.
Step:4 Press the weight or handles away while keeping your trunk braced.
Step:5 Keep the palms facing each other and the wrists straight.
Step:6 Lower the weight to its starting height under control before pressing again.

name: assisted standing triceps extension (with towel)
instructions: Step:1 Stand and set your feet about shoulder width and hold a towel with both hands behind your head.
Step:2 Hold your elbows near your ears and your upper arms stationary.
Step:3 Set the upper arms in place before extending the elbows.
Step:4 Keep the upper arms steady and extend through the elbows to move the weight.
Step:5 Keep the upper arms steady while the forearms travel.
Step:6 Bend the elbows slowly to return to the start of the next rep.

name: dumbbell clean
instructions: Step:1 Stand and set your feet about shoulder width, holding a dumbbell in each hand with palms facing down.
Step:2 Bend your knees and lower your hips into a squat position, with your spine steady and chest up.
Step:3 Brace before the pull and keep the load close to the body.
Step:4 Drive through the legs and hips, then guide the weight to its receiving position.
Step:5 Receive the load with the torso braced and feet stable.
Step:6 Stand tall to finish, then lower the weight under control before the next rep.

name: cocoons
instructions: Step:1 Settle onto your back with your knees bent and feet planted.
Step:2 Set your hands behind your head with your elbows pointing outwards.
Step:3 Set the pelvis and keep the neck relaxed before curling upward.
Step:4 Curl your rib cage toward your pelvis, letting the abdominals move the torso.
Step:5 Leave a little space between the chin and chest; keep the movement in the torso.
Step:6 Lower the shoulders or torso with control before the next curl.

name: Machine Seated Row
instructions: Step:1 Set the seat height and footrests to a comfortable position.
Step:2 Take a seat on the machine with your chest against the pad and your feet on the footrests.
Step:3 Set the torso and allow the arms to reach forward without rounding excessively.
Step:4 Draw your elbows back and bring the handle or weight toward your torso.
Step:5 Bring the elbows back without jerking the torso.
Step:6 Reach the arms forward again without letting the torso lurch.

name: dumbbell standing concentration curl
instructions: Step:1 Stand and set your feet about shoulder width and hold a dumbbell in one hand, with your arm straight and palm facing inwards.
Step:2 Set your opposite hand on your thigh for support.
Step:3 Set the shoulders and upper arms before bending the elbows.
Step:4 Bend your elbows to bring the weight toward your shoulders without swinging your torso.
Step:5 Keep the torso quiet and let the elbow bend lift the weight.
Step:6 Lower until the elbows are nearly straight, keeping the upper arms still.

name: Dumbbell Close-Grip Press
instructions: Step:1 Take a seat on a flat bench with a dumbbell in each hand, resting on your thighs.
Step:2 Use your thighs to help raise the dumbbells, lift the dumbbells one at a time so that you can hold them in front of you at shoulder width.
Step:3 Brace the torso and align the wrists with the forearms.
Step:4 Press the weight or handles away while keeping your trunk braced.
Step:5 Keep the wrists stacked and use a shoulder path that feels natural.
Step:6 Lower the weight to its starting height under control before pressing again.

name: Barbell Rollout
instructions: Step:1 Get down on the floor and hold a barbell with both hands, about shoulder width.
Step:2 Guide the barbell forward, extending your arms and keeping your core engaged.
Step:3 Tighten the abdomen and keep the pelvis tucked before the arms reach away.
Step:4 Reach the arms away while keeping your ribs and pelvis aligned; stop before the lower back sags.
Step:5 Stop reaching when the lower back starts to sag.
Step:6 Pull back to the start through your shoulders and abdominals, keeping the same body line.

name: assisted standing chin-up
instructions: Step:1 Set the machine to your desired assistance level.
Step:2 Step onto the foot platform and grip the handles with palms facing down, just beyond shoulder width.
Step:3 Begin from a controlled hang with the shoulders active rather than slack.
Step:4 Pull your elbows down and bring your upper chest toward the bar without kicking your legs.
Step:5 Avoid swinging the legs to clear the bar.
Step:6 Lower to long arms without dropping suddenly from the top.

name: assisted standing triceps extension (with towel)
instructions: Step:1 Stand and set your feet about shoulder width and hold a towel with both hands behind your head.
Step:2 Hold your elbows near your ears and your upper arms stationary.
Step:3 Set the upper arms in place before extending the elbows.
Step:4 Keep the upper arms steady and extend through the elbows to move the weight.
Step:5 Keep the upper arms steady while the forearms travel.
Step:6 Bend the elbows slowly to return to the start of the next rep.

name: dumbbell lying pronation on floor
instructions: Step:1 Settle onto the floor with your face down and your arms extended straight out in front of you, holding a dumbbell in each hand.
Step:2 Rotate your palms so they are facing down toward the floor.
Step:3 Keep the elbows relaxed so the small muscles of the hand or forearm take the load.
Step:4 Move through the wrists or fingers while the forearms stay supported and still.
Step:5 Use a small, smooth range without swinging the elbows.
Step:6 Ease back to the start without letting the load fall from your hands.

name: cable decline fly
instructions: Step:1 Set the cable machine to a decline position.
Step:2 Face the away from the machine from a stable stance with feet about shoulder width.
Step:3 Keep a soft elbow bend and set the shoulders before moving the arms.
Step:4 With a soft bend in the elbows, sweep your arms together in a wide arc.
Step:5 Keep the elbow angle nearly unchanged through the arc.
Step:6 Open the arms back along the same arc without dropping the load.

name: weighted kneeling step with swing
instructions: Step:1 Begin in a kneeling position with your knees about hip width and your back straight.
Step:2 Take a weight in each hand, with your arms extended straight down in front of you.
Step:3 Set the shoulders and let the weight move back between the legs as the hips hinge.
Step:4 Hinge back, then drive the hips forward to send the weight up; let the arms guide it.
Step:5 Let the hips, not the shoulders, provide the power.
Step:6 Let the weight fall naturally and hinge again for the next swing.

name: dumbbell incline row
instructions: Step:1 Angle the bench to roughly 45 degrees.
Step:2 Take hold of a dumbbell in each hand and Take a seat on the bench with your chest against the incline.
Step:3 Set the torso and allow the arms to reach forward without rounding excessively.
Step:4 Draw your elbows back and bring the handle or weight toward your torso.
Step:5 Bring the elbows back without jerking the torso.
Step:6 Reach the arms forward again without letting the torso lurch.

name: kettlebell alternating press on floor
instructions: Step:1 Begin by lying on your back on the floor with your knees bent and feet planted.
Step:2 Take a kettlebell in each hand, with your palms facing toward your feet and your arms extended straight up toward the ceiling.
Step:3 Brace the torso and align the wrists with the forearms.
Step:4 Press the weight or handles away while keeping your trunk braced.
Step:5 Finish one side's motion before the other side takes over.
Step:6 Lower the weight to its starting height under control before pressing again; switch sides when the set calls for it.

name: side hip abduction
instructions: Step:1 Stand and set your feet about shoulder width and your hands on your hips.
Step:2 Transfer your weight to one leg and lift the opposite leg out to the side, keeping it straight.
Step:3 Brace the abdomen and keep the shoulders anchored to the support.
Step:4 Open the knees or legs against resistance without shifting your torso.
Step:5 Slow the legs before they pull the lower back out of position.
Step:6 Lower the legs slowly without swinging or losing your trunk position.

name: Smith Machine Incline Triceps Extension
instructions: Step:1 Set the seat of the smith machine so that the bar is at shoulder height.
Step:2 Take a seat on the bench with your back against the pad and your feet planted.
Step:3 Set the upper arms in place before extending the elbows.
Step:4 Keep the upper arms steady and extend through the elbows to move the weight.
Step:5 Keep the upper arms steady while the forearms travel.
Step:6 Bend the elbows slowly to return to the start of the next rep.

name: scapula dips
instructions: Step:1 Begin by standing with your feet about shoulder width and your arms extended in front of you.
Step:2 Bend your knees slightly and hinge forward at the hips, with your spine steady.
Step:3 Set the shoulders down and keep the elbows pointed mostly behind you.
Step:4 Bend the elbows to lower between the supports; stop at a comfortable shoulder depth.
Step:5 Choose a depth that lets the shoulders stay comfortable.
Step:6 Press through the hands to rise, then reset the shoulders before another rep.

name: cable bench press
instructions: Step:1 Set the cable machine to chest height and attach the handles.
Step:2 Face the away from the machine from a stable stance with feet about shoulder width.
Step:3 Brace the torso and align the wrists with the forearms.
Step:4 Press the weight or handles away while keeping your trunk braced.
Step:5 Keep the wrists stacked and use a shoulder path that feels natural.
Step:6 Lower the weight to its starting height under control before pressing again.

name: Machine Reverse-Grip Preacher Curl
instructions: Step:1 Fit the seat to your body, then settle into the machine.
Step:2 Hold the handles with palms facing up.
Step:3 Set the working upper arm against the preacher pad and leave the elbow free to bend.
Step:4 Curl the weight while your upper arms stay in contact with the pad.
Step:5 Keep the palms in the chosen grip without bending the wrists back.
Step:6 Lower until the elbows are nearly straight, keeping the upper arms still.

name: smith leg press
instructions: Step:1 Set the seat and footplate of the smith machine to a comfortable position.
Step:2 Take a seat on the machine with your back against the backrest and your feet about shoulder width on the footplate.
Step:3 Set your feet firmly on the plate and keep the hips against the seat.
Step:4 Bend the knees to bring the platform toward you, then press it away through the feet.
Step:5 Stop the descent before the hips lift from the seat.
Step:6 Return along the same path at a controlled pace.

name: barbell wrist curl
instructions: Step:1 Plant both feet while seated on a bench; your forearms resting on your thighs, holding a barbell with palms facing up.
Step:2 Let the barbell to roll down to your fingertips, keeping your wrists straight.
Step:3 Keep the elbows relaxed so the small muscles of the hand or forearm take the load.
Step:4 Move through the wrists or fingers while the forearms stay supported and still.
Step:5 Use a small, smooth range without swinging the elbows.
Step:6 Ease back to the start without letting the load fall from your hands.

name: barbell upright row
instructions: Step:1 Stand and set your feet about shoulder width and hold a barbell with palms facing down, hands just beyond shoulder width.
Step:2 Keep the barbell hanging ahead of your thighs, arms straight.
Step:3 Set the torso and allow the arms to reach forward without rounding excessively.
Step:4 Draw your elbows back and bring the handle or weight toward your torso.
Step:5 Bring the elbows back without jerking the torso.
Step:6 Reach the arms forward again without letting the torso lurch.

name: Dumbbell Single-Arm Shoulder Press
instructions: Step:1 Stand and set your feet about shoulder width and hold a dumbbell in one hand at shoulder level, palm facing forward.
Step:2 Press the dumbbell upward until your arm is straight overhead.
Step:3 Brace the torso and align the wrists with the forearms.
Step:4 Press the weight or handles away while keeping your trunk braced.
Step:5 Keep both shoulders level and resist turning toward the working arm.
Step:6 Lower the weight to its starting height under control before pressing again; switch sides when the set calls for it.

name: Dumbbell Seated Single-Arm Biceps Curl On Exercise Ball With Leg Raised
instructions: Step:1 Take a seat on an exercise ball with your feet planted and your back straight.
Step:2 Take a dumbbell in one hand with your palm facing up and your arm straight.
Step:3 Set the shoulders and upper arms before bending the elbows.
Step:4 Bend your elbows to bring the weight toward your shoulders without swinging your torso.
Step:5 Keep both shoulders level and resist turning toward the working arm.
Step:6 Lower until the elbows are nearly straight, keeping the upper arms still; switch sides when the set calls for it.

name: kettlebell seated press
instructions: Step:1 Take a seat on a bench with your back straight and feet planted.
Step:2 Take a kettlebell in each hand at shoulder height, palms facing forward.
Step:3 Brace the torso and align the wrists with the forearms.
Step:4 Press the weight or handles away while keeping your trunk braced.
Step:5 Keep the wrists stacked and use a shoulder path that feels natural.
Step:6 Lower the weight to its starting height under control before pressing again.

name: kettlebell sumo high pull
instructions: Step:1 Stand and set your feet wider than about shoulder width, toes pointing outwards.
Step:2 Take a kettlebell with both hands ahead of your body, arms extended downwards.
Step:3 Brace before the pull and keep the load close to the body.
Step:4 Drive up from the wide stance and pull the kettlebell toward the upper chest, leading with the elbows.
Step:5 Receive the load with the torso braced and feet stable.
Step:6 Stand tall to finish, then lower the weight under control before the next rep.

name: Seated Roller Shoulder Flexion And Retraction
instructions: Step:1 Take a seat on a flat surface with your legs extended in front of you.
Step:2 Take hold of the roller with both hands, palms facing down, and place it on your thighs.
Step:3 Tighten the abdomen and keep the pelvis tucked before the arms reach away.
Step:4 Roll the roller away along your legs as the arms reach forward, then draw it back toward your thighs.
Step:5 Stop reaching when the lower back starts to sag.
Step:6 Pull back to the start through your shoulders and abdominals, keeping the same body line.

name: Barbell Reverse-Grip Incline Bench Row
instructions: Step:1 Angle the bench to roughly 45 degrees.
Step:2 Take a seat on the bench facing the backrest with your chest against it.
Step:3 Set the torso and allow the arms to reach forward without rounding excessively.
Step:4 Draw your elbows back and bring the handle or weight toward your torso.
Step:5 Keep the palms in the chosen grip without bending the wrists back.
Step:6 Reach the arms forward again without letting the torso lurch.

name: dumbbell rear fly
instructions: Step:1 Stand and set your feet about shoulder width and hold a dumbbell in each hand.
Step:2 Bend your knees slightly and hinge forward at the hips, with your spine steady.
Step:3 Keep a soft elbow bend and set the shoulders before moving the arms.
Step:4 With a soft bend in the elbows, sweep your arms together in a wide arc.
Step:5 Keep the elbow angle nearly unchanged through the arc.
Step:6 Open the arms back along the same arc without dropping the load.

name: dumbbell palms in incline bench press
instructions: Step:1 Angle the bench to roughly 45 degrees.
Step:2 Take a seat on the bench with your back against the backrest and feet planted.
Step:3 Brace the torso and align the wrists with the forearms.
Step:4 Press the weight or handles away while keeping your trunk braced.
Step:5 Keep the wrists stacked and use a shoulder path that feels natural.
Step:6 Lower the weight to its starting height under control before pressing again.

name: Dumbbell Standing Single-Arm Concentration Curl
instructions: Step:1 Stand tall with your feet about shoulder width and hold a dumbbell in one hand, palm facing up.
Step:2 Set your free hand on your thigh for support.
Step:3 Set the shoulders and upper arms before bending the elbows.
Step:4 Bend your elbows to bring the weight toward your shoulders without swinging your torso.
Step:5 Keep both shoulders level and resist turning toward the working arm.
Step:6 Lower until the elbows are nearly straight, keeping the upper arms still; switch sides when the set calls for it.

name: cable standing crunch (with rope attachment)
instructions: Step:1 Connect a rope to a cable machine at chest height.
Step:2 Face the away from the machine from a stable stance with feet about shoulder width.
Step:3 Set the pelvis and keep the neck relaxed before curling upward.
Step:4 Curl your rib cage toward your pelvis, letting the abdominals move the torso.
Step:5 Leave a little space between the chin and chest; keep the movement in the torso.
Step:6 Lower the shoulders or torso with control before the next curl.

name: band hip lift
instructions: Step:1 Settle onto your back with your knees bent and feet planted.
Step:2 Set a resistance band just above your knees.
Step:3 Plant the feet and keep the ribs from flaring as the hips prepare to rise.
Step:4 Press through the feet and lift your hips until your torso and thighs line up.
Step:5 Control the band on the way back instead of letting it snap you into position.
Step:6 Lower the hips steadily and keep the feet planted for the next lift.

name: assisted hanging knee raise with throw down
instructions: Step:1 Suspend yourself from a pull-up bar with your arms straight and your palms turned away from you.
Step:2 Brace your trunk and lift your knees toward your chest, keeping your legs together.
Step:3 Brace the abdomen and keep the shoulders anchored to the support.
Step:4 Lift your legs by bracing your trunk and moving at the hips rather than swinging.
Step:5 Slow the legs before they pull the lower back out of position.
Step:6 Lower the legs slowly without swinging or losing your trunk position.

name: Medicine Ball Close-Grip Push Up
instructions: Step:1 Begin in a high plank position with your hands on the medicine ball, about shoulder width.
Step:2 Lower your body toward the ground by bending your elbows, keeping them close to your sides.
Step:3 Brace the abdomen and glutes so the shoulders, hips and ankles move together.
Step:4 Bend your elbows to lower your chest while keeping your body in one line.
Step:5 Keep the head in line with the spine as the elbows bend.
Step:6 Press back to straight arms, keeping the body line intact.

name: cable seated curl
instructions: Step:1 Take a seat on a cable machine with your feet planted and your back straight.
Step:2 Hold the cable attachment with palms facing up, and your arms straight.
Step:3 Set the shoulders and upper arms before bending the elbows.
Step:4 Bend your elbows to bring the weight toward your shoulders without swinging your torso.
Step:5 Keep the torso quiet and let the elbow bend lift the weight.
Step:6 Lower until the elbows are nearly straight, keeping the upper arms still.

name: barbell standing calf raise
instructions: Step:1 Stand and set your feet about shoulder width and place a barbell across your upper back.
Step:2 Before moving, raise your heels off the ground as high as possible, using only your toes.
Step:3 Let the ankles move freely while the rest of the body stays quiet.
Step:4 Rise through the balls of your feet, lifting the heels as high as you can without rocking.
Step:5 Pause at the top without rolling the ankles outward.
Step:6 Lower the heels at a measured pace before rising again.

name: weighted hyperextension (on stability ball)
instructions: Step:1 Set yourself face down on a stability ball with your hips resting on the ball and your feet against a wall for stability.
Step:2 Set your hands behind your head or cross them over your chest.
Step:3 Secure the hips and feet on the support before lifting.
Step:4 Raise your torso or legs until they line up with your body, without arching sharply at the lower back.
Step:5 Keep the ball steady and use the feet to manage your balance.
Step:6 Return along the same path at a controlled pace.

name: cable seated crunch
instructions: Step:1 Take a seat on a cable machine with your feet planted and your knees bent.
Step:2 Take hold of the cable handle with both hands and position it behind your head.
Step:3 Set the pelvis and keep the neck relaxed before curling upward.
Step:4 Curl your rib cage toward your pelvis, letting the abdominals move the torso.
Step:5 Leave a little space between the chin and chest; keep the movement in the torso.
Step:6 Lower the shoulders or torso with control before the next curl.

name: cable concentration curl
instructions: Step:1 Take a seat on a bench or chair with your feet planted and your knees soft.
Step:2 Take hold of the cable handle with palms facing up and rest your elbow against the inside of your thigh.
Step:3 Set the shoulders and upper arms before bending the elbows.
Step:4 Bend your elbows to bring the weight toward your shoulders without swinging your torso.
Step:5 Keep the torso quiet and let the elbow bend lift the weight.
Step:6 Lower until the elbows are nearly straight, keeping the upper arms still.

name: smith shoulder press
instructions: Step:1 Fit the seat to your body, then settle into the machine.
Step:2 Hold the bar with palms facing down, just beyond shoulder width.
Step:3 Brace the torso and align the wrists with the forearms.
Step:4 Press the weight or handles away while keeping your trunk braced.
Step:5 Keep the wrists stacked and use a shoulder path that feels natural.
Step:6 Lower the weight to its starting height under control before pressing again.

name: Barbell Wide Reverse-Grip Bench Press
instructions: Step:1 Settle onto a bench with your feet planted and your back pressed against the bench.
Step:2 Hold the barbell with a wide reverse grip, just beyond shoulder width.
Step:3 Brace the torso and align the wrists with the forearms.
Step:4 Press the weight or handles away while keeping your trunk braced.
Step:5 Keep the palms in the chosen grip without bending the wrists back.
Step:6 Lower the weight to its starting height under control before pressing again.

name: hamstring stretch
instructions: Step:1 Stand and set your feet about shoulder width.
Step:2 Move forward with your right foot and shift your weight onto your right leg.
Step:3 Settle into the starting position and take an easy breath before moving deeper.
Step:4 Ease toward the stretch until you feel mild tension; keep breathing and avoid bouncing.
Step:5 Stay in a mild stretch rather than pulling farther with momentum.
Step:6 Hold the position with steady breathing, then release gently; repeat on the other side if needed.

name: decline crunch
instructions: Step:1 Settle onto a decline bench with your feet secured and your knees bent at a 90-degree angle.
Step:2 Set your hands behind your head or across your chest.
Step:3 Set the pelvis and keep the neck relaxed before curling upward.
Step:4 Curl your rib cage toward your pelvis, letting the abdominals move the torso.
Step:5 Leave a little space between the chin and chest; keep the movement in the torso.
Step:6 Lower the shoulders or torso with control before the next curl.

name: bridge - mountain climber (cross body)
instructions: Step:1 Begin in a high plank position with your hands directly under your shoulders and your body in a straight line.
Step:2 Brace your trunk and lift your right foot off the ground, bringing your right knee toward your left elbow.
Step:3 Brace the trunk lightly before moving a limb.
Step:4 Move the working arm or leg while keeping the trunk steady and the breathing even.
Step:5 Keep the pelvis from rocking as the arm or leg moves.
Step:6 Reset your posture before changing sides or beginning the next rep.

name: split squats
instructions: Step:1 Stand and set your feet about shoulder width.
Step:2 Step forward with one foot and place it about two feet in front of the other foot.
Step:3 Brace the abdomen and spread pressure across the whole foot.
Step:4 Bend at the hips and knees to lower, keeping your feet grounded and knees tracking with the toes.
Step:5 Drive upward with the chest and hips rising together; keep the knees from collapsing inward.
Step:6 Stand fully, reset your footing and breathing, then begin the next descent.

name: cable palm rotational row
instructions: Step:1 Connect a handle to a cable machine at waist height.
Step:2 Face the machine from a stable stance with feet about shoulder width.
Step:3 Set the torso and allow the arms to reach forward without rounding excessively.
Step:4 Draw your elbows back and bring the handle or weight toward your torso.
Step:5 Bring the elbows back without jerking the torso.
Step:6 Reach the arms forward again without letting the torso lurch.

name: band seated hip internal rotation
instructions: Step:1 Take a seat on a chair or bench with your back straight and feet planted.
Step:2 Set a resistance band around your thighs, just above your knees.
Step:3 Set the pelvis and make the turn through the rib cage.
Step:4 Turn through the torso while the hips and lower body stay as steady as the setup allows.
Step:5 Control the band on the way back instead of letting it snap you into position.
Step:6 Return through center before turning to the other side.

name: Smith Single-Leg Floor Calf Raise
instructions: Step:1 Set yourself on the floor under the smith machine bar, turned away from the machine.
Step:2 Set the balls of your feet on a raised surface, such as a weight plate or block.
Step:3 Let the ankles move freely while the rest of the body stays quiet.
Step:4 Rise through the balls of your feet, lifting the heels as high as you can without rocking.
Step:5 Keep the pelvis level as the supporting leg does the work.
Step:6 Lower the heels at a measured pace before rising again; switch sides when the set calls for it.

name: lying leg-hip raise
instructions: Step:1 Settle onto your back with your legs extended and your arms by your sides.
Step:2 Set your hands under your glutes for support.
Step:3 Plant the feet and keep the ribs from flaring as the hips prepare to rise.
Step:4 Press through the feet and lift your hips until your torso and thighs line up.
Step:5 Stop when the hips line up with the torso; do not arch higher through the lower back.
Step:6 Lower the hips steadily and keep the feet planted for the next lift.

name: band single leg calf raise
instructions: Step:1 Stand and set your feet about hip width and place the band around the ball of your left foot.
Step:2 Use a stable object for balance if needed.
Step:3 Let the ankles move freely while the rest of the body stays quiet.
Step:4 Rise through the balls of your feet, lifting the heels as high as you can without rocking.
Step:5 Control the band on the way back instead of letting it snap you into position.
Step:6 Lower the heels at a measured pace before rising again.

name: Machine Horizontal Single-Leg Press
instructions: Step:1 Set the seat of the machine so that your knees are at a 90-degree angle when your feet are on the footplate.
Step:2 Take a seat on the machine with your back against the backrest and your feet about shoulder width on the footplate.
Step:3 Set your feet firmly on the plate and keep the hips against the seat.
Step:4 Bend the knees to bring the platform toward you, then press it away through the feet.
Step:5 Keep the pelvis level as the supporting leg does the work.
Step:6 Return along the same path at a controlled pace; switch sides when the set calls for it.

name: sled lying squat
instructions: Step:1 Set the sled machine to a comfortable weight.
Step:2 Settle onto your back on the sled machine with your feet on the footplate.
Step:3 Brace the abdomen and spread pressure across the whole foot.
Step:4 Bend at the hips and knees to lower, keeping your feet grounded and knees tracking with the toes.
Step:5 Drive upward with the chest and hips rising together; keep the knees from collapsing inward.
Step:6 Stand fully, reset your footing and breathing, then begin the next descent.

name: band horizontal pallof press
instructions: Step:1 Connect the band to a sturdy anchor point at waist height.
Step:2 Stand perpendicular to the anchor point with your feet about shoulder width.
Step:3 Brace the torso and align the wrists with the forearms.
Step:4 Press the weight or handles away while keeping your trunk braced.
Step:5 Control the band on the way back instead of letting it snap you into position.
Step:6 Lower the weight to its starting height under control before pressing again.

name: Dumbbell Reverse-Grip Incline Bench Two-Arm Row
instructions: Step:1 Angle the bench to roughly 45 degrees.
Step:2 Take a seat on the bench with your chest against the backrest and your feet planted.
Step:3 Set the torso and allow the arms to reach forward without rounding excessively.
Step:4 Draw your elbows back and bring the handle or weight toward your torso.
Step:5 Keep the palms in the chosen grip without bending the wrists back.
Step:6 Reach the arms forward again without letting the torso lurch.

name: bench dip on floor
instructions: Step:1 Take a seat on the edge of a bench or chair with your hands gripping the edge, fingers pointing forward.
Step:2 Move your butt off the bench, supporting your weight with your hands.
Step:3 Set the shoulders down and keep the elbows pointed mostly behind you.
Step:4 Bend the elbows to lower between the supports; stop at a comfortable shoulder depth.
Step:5 Choose a depth that lets the shoulders stay comfortable.
Step:6 Press through the hands to rise, then reset the shoulders before another rep.

name: barbell decline pullover
instructions: Step:1 Get onto a decline bench with your head lower than your hips and your feet secured.
Step:2 Take hold of the barbell with a pronated grip (palms turned away from you) and your hands just beyond shoulder width.
Step:3 Set the ribs down and keep a small elbow bend before lowering the weight.
Step:4 Lower the weight in an arc behind your head until you feel a comfortable shoulder stretch.
Step:5 Keep the ribs down as the arms travel overhead.
Step:6 Pull the weight back over the chest along the same arc, without lifting the ribs.

name: kettlebell windmill
instructions: Step:1 Stand and set your feet about shoulder width, holding a kettlebell in your right hand overhead.
Step:2 Before moving, rotate your left foot outwards about 45 degrees and keep your right foot pointing forward.
Step:3 Set the pelvis and make the turn through the rib cage.
Step:4 Turn through the torso while the hips and lower body stay as steady as the setup allows.
Step:5 Keep the turn smooth instead of throwing the arms across the body.
Step:6 Return through center before turning to the other side.

name: cable triceps pushdown (v-bar)
instructions: Step:1 Connect a v-bar attachment to the cable machine at the highest setting.
Step:2 Face the cable machine from a stable stance with feet about shoulder width.
Step:3 Stand far enough from the stack for the cable to stay taut.
Step:4 Keep your elbows near your ribs and straighten your arms against the cable.
Step:5 Keep the elbows close to the body instead of letting the shoulders swing.
Step:6 Return along the same path at a controlled pace.

name: weighted lunge with swing
instructions: Step:1 Stand and set your feet about shoulder width, holding a weight in each hand.
Step:2 Step forward with your right foot, lowering your body into a lunge position.
Step:3 Set the shoulders and let the weight move back between the legs as the hips hinge.
Step:4 Hinge back, then drive the hips forward to send the weight up; let the arms guide it.
Step:5 Let the hips, not the shoulders, provide the power.
Step:6 Let the weight fall naturally and hinge again for the next swing.

name: chest dip
instructions: Step:1 Set yourself on parallel bars with your arms straight and your body straight.
Step:2 Before moving, lower your body by bending your elbows until your shoulders are below your elbows.
Step:3 Set the shoulders down and keep the elbows pointed mostly behind you.
Step:4 Bend the elbows to lower between the supports; stop at a comfortable shoulder depth.
Step:5 Choose a depth that lets the shoulders stay comfortable.
Step:6 Press through the hands to rise, then reset the shoulders before another rep.

name: dumbbell pullover
instructions: Step:1 Settle onto a bench with your head at one end and your feet on the floor.
Step:2 Take a dumbbell with both hands and extend your arms straight above your chest.
Step:3 Set the ribs down and keep a small elbow bend before lowering the weight.
Step:4 Lower the weight in an arc behind your head until you feel a comfortable shoulder stretch.
Step:5 Keep the ribs down as the arms travel overhead.
Step:6 Pull the weight back over the chest along the same arc, without lifting the ribs.

name: barbell incline bench press
instructions: Step:1 Angle the bench to roughly 45 degrees.
Step:2 Get onto the bench with your feet planted.
Step:3 Brace the torso and align the wrists with the forearms.
Step:4 Press the weight or handles away while keeping your trunk braced.
Step:5 Keep the wrists stacked and use a shoulder path that feels natural.
Step:6 Lower the weight to its starting height under control before pressing again.

name: triceps dip (between benches)
instructions: Step:1 Take a seat on a bench with your hands gripping the edge of the bench, fingers pointing forward.
Step:2 Move your butt off the bench, supporting your weight with your hands.
Step:3 Set the shoulders down and keep the elbows pointed mostly behind you.
Step:4 Bend the elbows to lower between the supports; stop at a comfortable shoulder depth.
Step:5 Choose a depth that lets the shoulders stay comfortable.
Step:6 Press through the hands to rise, then reset the shoulders before another rep.

name: incline twisting sit-up
instructions: Step:1 Angle the bench to roughly 45 degrees.
Step:2 Get onto the bench with your feet secured under the foot pads.
Step:3 Set the pelvis and keep the neck relaxed before curling upward.
Step:4 Curl your rib cage toward your pelvis, letting the abdominals move the torso.
Step:5 Leave a little space between the chin and chest; keep the movement in the torso.
Step:6 Lower the shoulders or torso with control before the next curl.

name: Single-Leg Donkey Calf Raise
instructions: Step:1 Stand and set your feet about shoulder width, toes pointing forward.
Step:2 Set your hands on a stable surface for support, such as a wall or a bar.
Step:3 Let the ankles move freely while the rest of the body stays quiet.
Step:4 Rise through the balls of your feet, lifting the heels as high as you can without rocking.
Step:5 Keep the pelvis level as the supporting leg does the work.
Step:6 Lower the heels at a measured pace before rising again; switch sides when the set calls for it.

name: cable seated row
instructions: Step:1 Take a seat on the cable row machine with your feet flat on the footrests and your knees soft.
Step:2 Hold the handles with palms facing down, with your spine steady and your shoulders relaxed.
Step:3 Set the torso and allow the arms to reach forward without rounding excessively.
Step:4 Draw your elbows back and bring the handle or weight toward your torso.
Step:5 Bring the elbows back without jerking the torso.
Step:6 Reach the arms forward again without letting the torso lurch.

name: kettlebell double alternating hang clean
instructions: Step:1 Stand and set your feet about shoulder width, holding a kettlebell in each hand with palms facing down.
Step:2 Bend your knees slightly and hinge forward at the hips, with your spine steady and chest up.
Step:3 Brace before the pull and keep the load close to the body.
Step:4 Drive through the legs and hips, then guide the weight to its receiving position.
Step:5 Finish one side's motion before the other side takes over.
Step:6 Stand tall to finish, then lower the weight under control before the next rep; switch sides when the set calls for it.

name: dumbbell standing overhead press
instructions: Step:1 Stand and set your feet about shoulder width, holding a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder level with your palms facing forward.
Step:2 Press the dumbbells upward until your arms are straight overhead.
Step:3 Brace the torso and align the wrists with the forearms.
Step:4 Press the weight or handles away while keeping your trunk braced.
Step:5 Keep the wrists stacked and use a shoulder path that feels natural.
Step:6 Lower the weight to its starting height under control before pressing again.

name: stationary bike walk
instructions: Step:1 Set the seat height and position on the stationary bike to ensure proper alignment.
Step:2 Set your feet on the pedals and secure them with the straps if available.
Step:3 Start at a pace that lets the feet and arms move in sync.
Step:4 Move at a repeatable pace, keeping the motion smooth and your breathing steady.
Step:5 Keep the pattern repeatable as speed increases.
Step:6 Keep the rhythm for the planned interval, slowing if your form starts to slip.

name: archer push up
instructions: Step:1 Begin in a push-up position with your hands just beyond shoulder width.
Step:2 Reach one arm straight out to the side, parallel to the ground.
Step:3 Brace the abdomen and glutes so the shoulders, hips and ankles move together.
Step:4 Shift toward one hand and bend that elbow while the other arm straightens to the side.

instructions: Step:1 Prepare the smith machine with the bar at hip height.

name: Machine T Bar Row

instructions: Step:1 Stand tall with your feet about shoulder width and hold a barbell with palms facing up.

name: dumbbell single arm overhead carry
instructions: Step:1 Stand tall and set your feet about shoulder width, holding a dumbbell in one hand.
